status: Author assessment of test coverage, not model scores or a percentage of rubric completeness.

dimensions.label: Promise / commitment fidelity
dimensions.evidence: Explicit scope, start, approval and delivery conditions appear in the briefs; grounding checks also catch invented commitments.
dimensions.limitation: No long SOW with interacting payment, liability, staffing and service-level clauses.

dimensions.label: Evidence grounding
dimensions.evidence: Every brief includes the grounding criterion; target-versus-result and causality checks add task-specific coverage.
dimensions.limitation: No supplied citation excerpts or real-link support traps. URL hygiene and citation entailment are untested.

dimensions.label: Numbers integrity
dimensions.evidence: Vendor totals, fee/rate arithmetic, thresholds, observed reductions and target-versus-actual distinctions are specified.
dimensions.limitation: No independent output-arithmetic recomputation. Schedule arithmetic and complex prose/table reconciliation are not systematically tested. The readout calculation-omission gate has a documented prompt mismatch.

dimensions.label: Internal consistency
dimensions.evidence: Launch timing and pre/post-acceptance ownership have explicit checks; grounding review can catch other contradictions.
dimensions.limitation: No deliberately conflicting source packets or long-document cross-section stress test.

dimensions.label: Decision readiness
dimensions.evidence: Briefs require recommendations, decisions, prerequisites and follow-up actions under stated constraints.
dimensions.limitation: Most decisions are constrained by a clear mandatory gate. Complex strategic tradeoffs and recommendation quality beyond those gates are not separately measured.

dimensions.label: Language precision
dimensions.evidence: Commitment, owner and dependency checks plus the style lens assess some material ambiguity. Ambiguous signatory and reassurance cases remain unresolved.
dimensions.limitation: No separately scored precision dimension or independent calibration of will/should/may and implied obligations.

dimensions.label: Anti-slop / Claudespeak
dimensions.assessment: Full lens applied; narrow task distribution
dimensions.evidence: The frozen 29-category lens is reviewed, and character/candidate scans are saved. Factual-contrast exceptions are applied.
dimensions.limitation: Keyword matches alone are not defects. Short synthetic briefs do not prove coverage of every rhetorical pattern or writing genre; judgment remains unblinded.

dimensions.label: MECE accountability (when applicable)
dimensions.evidence: The handoff brief separates defect fixes from incident ownership and exposes an unassigned rehearsal organizer.
dimensions.limitation: No broad responsibility matrix with overlapping roles and multiple transitions. Applicability/N/A behavior is not independently tested.
